properties.statement: THE REPORT A SESSION READS TO DECIDE WHAT TO LOOK AT WAS 91.5% ROLL CALL. `graph_report` measured 166,934 characters AFTER the duplicate emission was already removed — 152,803 of them the full verification roll. 197 checks, 196 of them passing. The one read that exists to point a session somewhere spent nine tenths of itself saying '196 passing, 1 planned'. It is also what the where-am-i skill reads, so 'where does this design stand' was refused on a mature design. || AND 93% OF THE ROLL WAS ONE FIELD: `name`, 129,994 chars over 197 entries. 113 OF THE 197 NAMES RUN OVER 25 WORDS AND THE LONGEST IS 654 — whole reports written into a name because `description` was declared and unreachable from `add_verification` for a long time. ⇒ THE BULK WAS NOT INFORMATION, IT WAS A DATA-ENTRY SCAR, and the sharpest clue was already on the wire: `graph_report_markdown` renders THE SAME REPORT for a human in 6,172 bytes, 27× smaller. || BOTH MECHANISMS ALREADY EXISTED AND NEITHER HAD BEEN POINTED HERE. `vocabulary_coverage` withholds its flat list unless asked (`include_unused`); `loop_status` already returns a verification DIGEST with names cut at 25 words and the cut announced. Reusing that same digest is why the truncation is not written twice — and it is also why `loop_status`'s `full_list` pointer had to move from `graph_report` to `graph_report {include_verifications: true}`, or a withheld list would have been left with a stale retrieval instruction, which is worse than never withholding it. MEASURED: 166,934 → 15,480 bytes on the wire, roll still reachable at 165,207. || ⚠️ THE LIMIT, STATED RATHER THAN HIDDEN: the digest keeps every check that is NOT currently passing IN FULL, because that is what a reader acts on. So it is flat in the PASSING remainder, not in the check count. Here 196 of 197 pass and the saving is 11×; ON A DESIGN MID-BUILD WITH TWO HUNDRED `planned` CHECKS THIS REPORT WOULD BE LARGE AGAIN. That case is real, UNMEASURED, and deliberately not built for — the same 'measure before you cut' rule that cancelled the planned `loop_status` work an hour earlier. || A SECOND LIMIT WORTH SAYING: budgeting the report stops 113 essay-length names flooding a reply; IT DOES NOT MOVE THE REPORTS OUT OF THE NAME FIELDS. `add_verification` now reaches `description` and `findings`, so new checks land correctly and the existing 113 stay stranded. || SOURCE: measured 2026-08-23 on reflow2 0.38.0, driving the built binary over real stdio.
